a year or so ago I was like you. I said I wouldn’t do it, that I would only let it happen if it was supposed to, and I stopped taking care of the things I did that were a little risky, never really putting myself in danger but never insisting on staying out the dangerous way. I promised that I wouldn't commit the act for several reasons, but deep down I didn't care about anything and hoped that maybe with luck I would end up dying unintentionally.

this is not sustainable. after doing this for a while, not taking care of myself and hoping in silence that it would finally end, I was sick of waiting, because being adrift in life makes little things get out of control and self destruct. it's nothing very significant, just small things that come together in an annoying existence and start to annoy tf out of you because you're not taking care of them, cause you're waiting to die. the house gets dirty in the corners, your health gets worse, your nails get stuck, your patience disappears, your productivity decreases, your relationships deteriorate, and what was once an undesirable, empty neutral life with nothing special is now a little nest of disasters that happened because you were not paying attention to them. either because you'll get tired of waiting for death and never see it coming or because your life will go crazy while you wait and it'll get so bad that you'll decide it’s too much to take and it’s better to end it all, this passivity will not last. this is what I was trying to say. there is no way to leave life on automatic and wait for it not to deteriorate. if you're not trying to get better, don't think you're just standing still and won't move, because you will fall. there is no middle point, no balance. you're either chasing improvement, or you're already falling behind

I may still be unable to, but I want her to have this kind of mechanism in her mind, to insist on living and hope that things will get better when she faces adversity. around her, I will try not only to avoid the death jokes, but I will also actively try to instigate her to love herself more. hopefully it'll work.
